summary: Phase C (AGRIOS Market Pulse weekly digest) full-stack regression. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass; all 6 frontend scenarios pass. Digest preview, prefs persistence, mock email dispatch, admin blast/log, WhatsApp share flow all verified. Email is correctly MOCKED (provider='mock', status='logged') per user decision — will auto-upgrade once RESEND_API_KEY is set.
critical_code_review_comments: services/digest.py: _build_digest suppliers section issues one listings+orders round-trip per verified farmer — fine at seed scale but becomes N+1 at production scale; consider an aggregation pipeline or a 10-supplier cap before the inner queries.

services/digest.py: Farmer price_guidance compares across countries (no country filter on peers). For cross-border platforms this is OK, but for NG-only comparisons the median may skew — consider scoping peers by country_code.

server.py _run_digest_blast blocks on per-user sends sequentially (no asyncio.gather). With real Resend + 1k users this will be slow — batch via asyncio.gather(..., return_exceptions=True) in chunks of 20.

server.py _digest_scheduler_loop sleeps are implicit — confirm the loop has an `await asyncio.sleep(3600)` at the end (not viewed in the visible range); if missing it would busy-loop. Please sanity-check lines 2600-2615.

Digest.jsx: savePrefs optimistically clicks via onClick then awaits — during the in-flight PUT the button stays showing old state which can look unresponsive. Consider optimistic update with rollback on error.

Digest.jsx line 246: cta_url.replace regex strips origin only if http(s) prefix present; falls back to '/app' when empty. Works, but a SAFE_INTERNAL_LINK helper is cleaner and handles edge-cases (e.g. mailto:).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase C digest feature is green. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_phase_c_digest.py covers preview/prefs/send-me-now/admin trigger/log/role-based headlines/TEST_ exclusion. Toggling prefs.email for buyer@agriflow.ng during the prefs test leaves it set back to true at the end — but if a test interrupts mid-flight the buyer may be left with email=false. Admin /api/digest/trigger writes 1 row per opted-in user to digest_log on every call (mock mode), so the digest_log collection grows monotonically — you may want to prune old entries in a future iteration. Scheduler runs via asyncio.create_task at startup and should not be exercised directly.
